name: Iris Lennox
source: Marnie's Grandmother on her father's side. She lives in a very rural part of England. Marnie is forced to stay at her grandmother's house while her parents go on holiday to France. She is convinced that the forest behind her house has fairies. Everyone else thinks she's gone senile because she always brings this up.
